title: Super_creeper
description: Transform every creeper encounter into a heart-pounding survival challenge with massive, tactical-scale explosions. This mod boosts explosion power up to 30.0 while ensuring game stability with optimized crash-prevention code.🧨💥
body:
Unstoppable Power: Vanilla creepers are a joke. Our creepers pack a punch with an explosion power of 15.0F (5x stronger!).

Charged Nightmare: If you encounter a Charged Creeper, run. With a power of 30.0F, they leave craters that look like lunar landscapes. 🌑

Anti-Crash Technology: We’ve optimized the explosion logic to prevent your game from freezing or crashing, even when half the forest disappears in a second. 🛠️

True Survival: Perfect for hardcore players, modpacks, or anyone who thinks their obsidian base is "too safe."
